(rule!
 ;; On a fresh canvas, fill each object's whole BBOX with that object's color.
 (for/fold ((out (empty-grid h w 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0))))
   (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
     (paint-cells out
                  (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb)
                                     (third bb) (fourth bb))
                  (obj-color obj)))))
